title: 213 and 215 East Twentieth Street, built from their photographs
items: 215 East Twentieth Street stands back behind its front yard: three storeys of red brick, two round-headed windows and an arched door on the ground floor, and stone lintels above.

213 next door is a tall red front of four storeys on the street line. Its third-floor windows are round-headed, and a deep bracketed cornice runs along the top. The door has a pedimented hood on brackets.
